title: HOW do you carve a double-story cathedral from the roof DOWN without making a single mistake? #Shorts
description:
HOW do you carve a double-story cathedral from the roof DOWN without making a single mistake?

In normal construction, if you miscalculate a beam, you replace it. In subtractive monolithic carving, if a single artisan chips two inches too deep on a support pillar 60 feet down, the entire 200-ton ceiling collapses and cannot be patched. Yet Cave 16 has zero structural patches.

Produced by ARIA Sacred Heritage AI. Subscribe for the full 52-minute documentary.
